prompt:
Create one friendly, abstract, clear comic-style biology learning illustration as an opaque PNG, horizontal about 16:9, native size near 1600 x 900. Match approachable classroom illustrations with bold rounded outlines, warm cream background and purple/green/orange accents. It must work at only 360 px wide: large objects, few large German labels, no dense text.
Subject: a given eukaryotic promoter model, DNA methylation can reduce transcription without changing the DNA base sequence. Show TWO clean comparison rows. In both rows show the same simple DNA segment as two rails with identical coloured paired rungs in the same order; draw a clearly highlighted promoter section before a small gene segment. The top promoter has few chemical methylation markers and three separate, newly produced simple mRNA squiggles at the right. The bottom has more small orange attached chemical-marker circles at corresponding promoter positions and ONE mRNA squiggle, so transcription is reduced, not necessarily zero. Keep the DNA rungs and gene shape absolutely identical in the two rows. Chemical marks are attached markers, never substituted base letters or deleted DNA. The orange marker circles may have a clear tiny CH3 legend only if legible, but the core meaning must need no tiny label. Simple functional arrows point from the gene to mRNA. No molecular mechanism, no lock/roadblock, no transcription factor hero, no universal on/off switch, no marks changing sequence, no DNA becoming RNA physically. Do not present all methylation as silencing or all marks as inhibitory everywhere.
Exact large German title: "DNA-Methylierung". Large shared label: "Gleiche Basenfolge". Large right label: "mRNA". Short footer: "In diesem Promotormodell". Keep other labels absent or minimal. No task numbers, no technical IDs, no logos, no watermark, no photorealism or sterile blueprint. This is an orientation model, not assessment data.
